name: Etched Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Gornek sends a carved tablet to young hunters. Jen'shan's mark calls them to train in the wild.

sections.title: A Summons to the Hunt
sections.body: After young hunters prove themselves against the boars near the Den, Gornek brings them a carved tablet. Jen'shan's mark is cut into the stone. She is a skilled troll huntswoman stationed nearby, and her message shows that seasoned hunters have noticed the recruit's grit. Now the lesson turns from surviving local dangers to disciplined training in the wild.

sections.title: The Sharing of Survival
sections.body: Jen'shan teaches that orcs and trolls have a long history within the Horde. Orcs brought renowned traditions of warriors and shamans. The Darkspear trolls carried ancient skills in stalking, tracking, and survival, which helped orcs endure life on Azeroth. As Jen'shan trains new hunters, the two peoples share what they know, bound by respect for the hunt.

faq.answer: Jen'shan sends the inscribed stone, and Gornek delivers it after you prove yourself in the Valley of Trials.
Jen'shan is in northern Durotar's Valley of Trials, among the other class instructors near the Den.

faq.q: Why do troll trainers teach orc hunters here?
faq.answer: Jen'shan says the Horde turned to trolls for hunting lore while struggling to survive on Azeroth. Orcs already knew the ways of warriors and shamans, and the two peoples still share their skills.

faq.q: What happens after turning in this tablet?
faq.answer: Jen'shan accepts you as her student and offers to teach you the basic techniques, shots, and survival practices of Horde hunters as you gain experience.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be finished before getting this tablet?
faq.answer: You must first finish Gornek's initial task, Cutting Teeth, by slaying mottled boars to prove your endurance.

faq.q: Can any class complete this quest?
faq.answer: Only novice hunters can receive this training summons in the Valley of Trials. Gornek gives other classes different summons.

angles.text: As a hunter, you find your first place among Horde hunters and begin learning from your local trainer in the wilderness.
As a troll, you can see how Darkspear hunting lore helped the Horde survive on Kalimdor and support its allies.
As an orc, you learn refined stalking and tracking from your Darkspear allies, adding to your people's warrior traditions.
As a member of the Horde, you see orcs and trolls share their distinct strengths to help both peoples survive.
